Purple Gate Station was a planned station on Eastcoast Line. It would have been operated by Peckern Transit, and would have been located in Peckern Purple Gate. However, due to changes in development plans of Peckern Line, this station was never built.

Fun Facts[]

  • Peckern Line originally had plans to serve this station. However, after changes in development plans, the plans to set up a station in here was aborted.
  • While the plans for Eastcoast Line were scrapped, the section between Beak Beach Station and Stone Shoal Station became a part of the Peckern South-East Coast Line. The Station corresponding to this station on Peckern South-East Coast Line is Purple Gate Station.

title: Purple Gate Tunnel
safeHtml:
Purple Gate Tunnel is an underwater tunnel in NR Los Sengas Division.

Description[]

  • Number of Tubes: 2
  • Length: 4470 m
  • Lines Served: Delta Line
  • Location: Belt Island Station - Purple Gate Station

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • At over 4 km long, this underwater tunnel broke the record of Beltsand Tunnel and became the longest underwater tunnel in Los Sengas. However, this record was later broken by Route 5 Tunnel.

Fun Facts[]

  • The livery and name of this station alludes to the programming language Python. A memorial for Python is also available at the Station Park next to Platform 1.
  • The original Station Number of New Edward Line for this station is 4-10, but due to the completion of Twenty Village Station, it is modified to 4-11.

History[]

  • September 18 2016: This station began services alongside New Edward Line.
  • July 27 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[2]
  • February 24 2021: The Akashi Line Part of this station began expansion.
  • February 26 2021: The Akashi Line Platforms and Concourse completed expansion. At the same day, Akashi Line extends from Rosifolius Station to this station.
  • May 19 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[3]

Python Delta Station is a station of Southern Corridor, Southern Corridor Rapid, Southern Corridor Express, Labyrinth Line, Labyrinth Line (Rapid) and Masquerade Line. It is operated by Nawis Railway, and is located at Los Sengas Twenty-Second Continent. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nazca Railway New Edward Line, Akashi Line (Python Delta Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station, alongside Causeway Bay Station and Royal Mount Station, is one of the "anchor points" for Glacier Line climbing to Elevated level from the south. As a result, Side Platforms are used for this station.
  • This station, alongside Royal Mount Station and Virtue Plateau Station, are built in tribute to Nabela Qoser, a former Hong Kong-based journalist and broadcaster.
  • Players usually have a misnomer of this station's Chinese Name that coincides with the Soft Drink Ribena.
  • The Glacier Line platforms of this station are completely sealed off despite being at Ground Level.
  • The section between this and Virtue Plateau Station adopts a "Bridge Core" design similar to that of Oasis Bay Line.

History[]

  • October 17 2020: This station began services alongside Glacier Line.
  • December 20 2024: This station began expansion of the Rover Line Part.
  • December 21 2024: This station completed expansion of the Rover Line part, but Rover Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • January 7 2025: Rover Line is established.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is named after the fact that Four Rivers converge near this station at the time of its construction.[2], and the river convergence resembles entryways. However, the four rivers have since disappeared due to development in the surrounding area.
  • Exits A-C of this station adopts a new design. The new exits feature a pillar near the exit that shows the exit number and the route numbers involved in the station.
  • Diagonal Squares exist at the ceilings of the concourse of this station in order to allude to Quadrilaterals.

History[]

  • January 17 2019: This station began services alongside Minecraft Line, but Stadow Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • December 24 2019: Stadow Line extended from Freedom Bay Station to Europa Checkpoint through this station, Stadow Line Phase 1 completed construction.[3]
  • October 6 2025: Exits F, G1 and G2 are added to this station while all existing exits are named.[4]

title: Quarter Basin Stabling Sidings
safeHtml:
Quarter Basin Stabling Sidings is one of the stabling sidings of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for East Ring Line and Egress Line. It is located to the south of Quarter Basin Station and the east of Parallel Bay Station. This Stabling Siding is designed to support Miner Bay Depot and Vector Bay Depot, and is estimated to have a capacity of up to 20 nine-carriage trains.

Contents

  • 1 Description
    • 1.1 Sidings
    • 1.2 Connecting Tracks
    • 1.3 Other Facts
  • 2 Gallery
  • 3 Citations and References

Description[]

Sidings[]

The two sides have 14 sidings in total, which can store 20 trains, including 15 East Ring Line trains and five Egress Line trains.

Connecting Tracks[]

The East Ring Line tracks enable trains to standby in both directions, and trains can go directly to Parallel Bay Station or Quarter Basin Station. However, the Egress Line tracks only lead to Parallel Bay Station as the curvature of curves to Rapid Rivulet Station are too small. Spurs are also set up on each track.

Other Facts[]

Besides of increasing the capacity for East Ring Line and Egress Line, this Stabling Siding is also constructed with enhancing East Ring Line dispatch frequencies in mind. The trains parked in this Stabling Siding are also managed by Vector Bay Depot.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Chinese name of this station coincidentally resembles Cheong Wa Dae, the former executive office of South Korea. As a result, the Exterior of this station resembles Cheong Wa Dae.
  • This station is the first Pseudoground Station built in Season 3.
  • While there is another Nawis Railway station with the same name (Southern Corridor Quillow Terrace Station), there are no connections between these two stations.
  • Reserved structure for New Edward Line already existed for this station in a fashion similar to Spinstone Plane Station upon construction.
  • As this station is located on a Terrace, the Daring Line Upper Platforms are considered to be beneath ground level despite being at Y=80. Similar configurations are seen at High Approach Station and Comet Terrace Station.
  • A Special arrangement exists at the elevator that travels to the New Edward Line Platforms. At the floor of New Edward Line Platforms, this elevator provides access to both the Concourse and the Daring Line Platforms. However, the Concourse and the Daring Line Platforms are not accessible with each other when this elevator is used.

History[]

  • July 15 2020: This station began services alongside Daring Line.
  • September 7 2021: New Edward Line extends from Kallen Bay Station to Le Monde Checkpoint through this station.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station was formerly a single-line station of Central Line and had services running to East Surrest Station until the takeover of Eternal Line.
  • This station is named after the fact that the exits of this station lead to five different biomes in Minecraft, namely Extreme Hills, Desert (Desert Village), Forest, Plains and Swamp. Polibiomes Station of Los Sengas Division is named in a similar manner.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after the fact that it is located at approximately five kilometers to the east of Intus Aquilo Gateway and is within Snowty District.
  • This station is the first station in Nazca Railway besides of Intus Aquilo Gateway to be located to the north of Intus Aquilo (X = -20000).

History[]

  • October 26 2020: Nazca Railway made spoilers about the structure of this station.[4]
  • October 27 2020: The Snowty Line and Mike Line part of this station completed construction.[5]
  • October 29 2020: This station began services alongside Glacier Line, but Snowty Line and Mike Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • March 13 2023: This station began setting up Snowty Line and Mike Line systems.
  • March 14 2023: This station completed setting up Snowty Line and Mike Line systems, Snowty Line and Mike Line Platforms are now open to the public.
  • March 15 2023: Snowty Line extends from The Colonnade Station to this station.
  • March 16 2023: Mike Line is established.

Fun Facts[]

  • As Tin Kam Station is planned to be an Elevated Station for Glinstrouß Line, to reduce the distance of the slope, the Glinstrouß Line Platforms are placed closer to ground level than usual.[2] Moreover, due to the fact that the transfer concourse is underground, it would be more convenient for Glinstrouß Line to be at a higher level as Everchord Line Platforms are north-south oriented in this station.[3]
  • The following features are added at this station as per the request of the Peckern North developer:[4]
    • The concourse needs to have a skylight.
    • As some exits have to be elevated, the are four different concourses scattered at four of the five stories of this station.
  • Exits E-J of this station are arranged in an anti-clockwise fashion.[5]
  • This Station features the first ever five-storey elevator in Nazca Railway. However, due to the number of floors involved, passengers could only traverse one floor at once when using that elevator.[6]
  • This Station is named after Ramseqeu Street, which runs perpendicularly with the Glinstrouß Line Platforms.

History[]

  • July 20 2021: This Station began construction.
  • July 23 2021: This Station completed construction.
  • July 24 2021: This station began services alongside Glinstrouß Line, but Everchord Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • July 28 2021: Everchord Line is established.
  • August 20 2021: This station completed exit naming.[7]
  • March 15 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • November 29 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[8]

Rapid Rivulet Station is a station on East Ring Line and Egress Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Egress. Passengers may also use this station to change to Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line, Hook Sand Rapid, Hook Sand Express (Rapid Rivulet Station) and SLT Line 2001 (Rapid Rivulet Railway Station Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • A small body of water exists at the edge of every floor in this station to stick to the theme of "Rivulet". While Orange Wool gives this station a vivid vibe, Blue Wool represents Water.[2]

History[]

  • July 19 2017: This station began services alongside East Ring Line, but Egress Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • July 24 2017: Egress Line is established.
  • July 8 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]
  • April 26 2024: Exits C3, E3 and F are added to this station to connect to the Element Hub Transit Station of the Same Name.[4]

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is built in a rectangular fashion to allude to the name of this station. Moreover, the Block of Gold is used in this station to allude to the aphorism of Time is Money, as time can be precious, and gold also alludes to "Precious".[2]

History[]

  • April 17 2018: This station began services alongside Abyss Line.
  • September 7 2022: This station completed expansion of the Phoenix Line section.[3]
  • September 9 2022: Phoenix Line extends from Lei Tiu Lau Station to this station.

Fun Facts[]

  • A section of on air tracks is located to the west of the station in a fashion similar to East Ring Line tracks around Origin Pond Station.
  • Recuérdame is Spanish for "Remember Me", which is also the name of the titular song of the 2017 film Coco. The Pinkish Blue color scheme of this station alludes to the fact that, for the railway builder, the color blue represents farewell.[2]
  • This Station is the third Station in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division in which the English Name of this station features Diacritic Marks, with the first two being Calmé Station and Bay Façade Station.
  • Due to the small projected ridership around this station, the Concourse of this station is located to the west and only uses half of the platform length.

History[]

  • December 26 2021: This station completed construction.[3]
  • December 27 2021: This station began services.

Station Souvenir Hints (Now Inaccessible)[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.

  • Stars: 1.5
  • Go ahead and Sprint! Run as fast as you can on the aerial footpath towards your souvenir.
  • Stars: 0.5
  • There exists a set of stairs on the external wall of the lavatory. Climb the set of stairs to reach the souvenir.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a pair of dyed leather boots.

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 0.5-1.5 (Dependent on the Parkour Skills of the player)
  • Sprint towards the end like an athlete!
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a water bottle.

Fun Facts[]

  • The concourse of this station is a plateau structure that does not have any support pillars, the first of its kind in Los Sengas.
  • This station is named after the Red Stadium, a large outdoors sports arena directly to the south of this station.
  • This station used to house a Los Sengas Coffee at the concourse. However, since the addition of the Station Title Banner, it has been demolished.
  • The Chinese name of this station, as well as the Red Stadium at the south, alludes to a series of outdoors Soccer-cum-Handball Courts, Basketball courts and Volleyball courts at North District Park in Sheung Shui.

History[]

  • April 21 2015: This station began services. New Edward Line and Stadium Line are established.
  • February 28 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • January 2 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[5]
  • June 2 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[6]
  • April 20 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[7]
  • July 12 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[8]
  • March 18 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • December 9 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[9]

The Regulations for Highly Permitted Island Development is a set of guidelines regarding Island development on West Metropolis Archipelago, Archipelago at Strait of Freedom. Internal Sea Archipelago and Rover Archipelago. This set of guidelines adopt the mode of "Specific Island Application".

English Version[]

Los Sengas of the City World includes a considerable number of islands. The Officials would like to grant players permission to develop some islands under limited rules. However, in order to maintain stable development of different player-owned islands and island supply, the following regulations apply to the development. Before applying an island, be sure to check out the followings whether you are eligible to apply:

  • Your warning record is less than 2
  • You do not own more than 1 island-class, and 2 isle-class islands in Los Sengas
  • The island you want was not belong to any player

How to apply an island:

  • Check the map and the owner list below
  • Contact the Chief Administrator Nazca Chan （me）
  • The Chief Administrator will provide you information and the plan of the island and whether you are eligible to apply
  • Tip: If you are not sure the island is available for you, please consider your second choice or further
  • Vague details such as “small city” or ”residential and commerical” etc. are NOT allowed for custom plans （Effective after 7th The First Month, Year 5）

When you apply an island, following benefits will be given to you:

  • You will grant a personal Creative Mode/Survival Mode Command Block switch on the island
  • If the island does not have Nazca Railway Station or Sava Light Transit linked to Nazca Railway Station, teleportation button at spawn will be set for you for quick travel
  • The island will be protected permanently
  • Private Space!

When you apply an island, be sure to follow the regulations below:

  • Do NOT use the Creative Mode Command Block switch outside the owned island
  • Do follow the plan of the island provided by the Chief Administrator
  • If there are public infrastructures （NR/NFC etc.）, you cannot modify any of their structure
  • Railways and Car-roads are allowed in Island-class island, but are NOT allowed in Isle-class island
  • Do obviously retain the shape of the natural coastline
  • No artificial island built on non-natural island’s continental shelf
  • Shall NOT exceed 9 builders within an island （Owner exclusive）

To conclude your development of an island, please inform me directly at Minecraft or using in-game /mail of your completion. After I inspect your completed island and passed, I will provide you a certificate of your island.

Citiations and Reference[]

Relish Island is one of the islands involved in the Centopia Nazca Railway Headquarters. Similar to Centopia Island and the other islands in Centopia, this island is also artificial.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Railway
    • 2.2 Roads
  • 3 Fun Facts
  • 4 Future Development
  • 5 History
  • 6 Gallery
  • 7 Citations and References

Location[]

Relish Island is located to the southwest of Hakeem Island, the west of Orama Island, the northwest of Leben Island and the east of Xofa. It also sits at the western edge of Centopia.

Transport[]

Railway[]

This island features two separate Nazca Railway stations, with Relish North Station serving Sparkling Line situated near the north coast of the island and Relish South Station serving Zephyr Line situated at the southwest of this island. Both stations serve as a means of access between Xofa and the Nazca Railway Headquarters as a whole.

Roads[]

(To be Added)

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this island Relish is an English word that can be defined as "Enjoyment" and "Pleasure".[2] It also corresponds to the chinese name of this island, which refers to "Discussing something enthusiastically".[3]
  • Development on this island have been sub-contracted to other developers in Los Sengas due to its close proximity with Xofa District.
  • Coincidentally, the shape of this island resembles the Station Control Room of Havenore Station.

Future Development[]

Immediately after reclamation works completed on this island, it was already announced that this island would feature a mall named "The American Mall", above which two different towers (Namely "Maple Tower" and "Eagle Tower") are situated, an amusement park named "The Red Carpet", a Park with a fountain, a Future Congress Center, and four parking lots, one along each coast of the island and two adjacent to The American Mall.

History[]

  • December 23 2023: This island completed reclamation works.
  • January 7 2024: Relish North Station and Relish South Station began services.
  • August 31 2024: This island completed road pavement.

Fun Facts[]

  • The first word of this station Relish is an English word that can be defined as "Enjoyment" and "Pleasure".[2] It also corresponds to the chinese name of this island, which refers to "Discussing something enthusiastically".[3]
  • Despite being built and having completed construction at the same time as Relish South Station, as this station was connected by tracks earlier than Relish South Station, the station number of this station is smaller than that of Relish South Station.
  • This station adopts a double-storey concourse design in a fashion similar to Airship Deck Station and Luk Tsuen Station.
  • Both stories of the concourse are divided into two wings. They are connected by a passageway that caves in a similar fashion to that of Relish Island. While the upper concourse passageway caves in to the north, the lower concourse passageway caves in to the south.
  • This station is one of the first two stations to be built in 2024, with the other new station being Relish South Station.

History[]

  • December 23 2023: The Island on which this station is located (Relish) completed reclamation works.
  • December 29 2023: This Station began construction.
  • January 5 2024: This Station completed construction.
  • January 7 2024: This Station began services.

Relish South Station is a station on Zephyr Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Centopia.

Fun Facts[]

  • The first word of this station Relish is an English word that can be defined as "Enjoyment" and "Pleasure".[2] It also corresponds to the chinese name of this island, which refers to "Discussing something enthusiastically".[3]
  • This station began construction, completed construction and began services in the same day as Relish North Station.
  • This station is one of the first two stations to be built in 2024, with the other new station being Relish North Station.

History[]

  • December 23 2023: The Island on which this station is located (Relish) completed reclamation works.
  • December 29 2023: This Station began construction.
  • January 5 2024: This Station completed construction.
  • January 7 2024: This Station began services.
